8f0c340db141c36d900946945b33de1d.overview: Young lovers Orfeu and Eurydice run through the favelas of Rio during Carnaval, on the lam from a hitman dressed like Death and Orfeu's vengeful fiancée Mira and passing between moments of fantasy and stark reality. This impressionistic retelling of the Greek legend of Orpheus and Eurydice introduced bossa nova to the world with its soundtrack by young Brazilian composers Luiz Bonfá and Antonio Carlos Jobim.
8f0c340db141c36d900946945b33de1d.tagline: The film that introduced Bossa Nova to the world...

8f14bb572c271cb17585e7aedb31c24b.overview: After four college girls rob a restaurant to fund their spring break in Florida, they get entangled with a weird dude with his own criminal agenda.
8f14bb572c271cb17585e7aedb31c24b.tagline: A little sun can bring out your dark side.

8f1508807086a6fe518dd409feec9bbe.overview: Charlie Brown, Linus and the entire Peanuts gang are off on a lively Easter egg hunt. They suspect they've spotted the Easter Bunny … but the trouble is, he looks a lot like a certain beagle who's near and dear to Charlie Brown's heart. Is it truly the Easter Bunny, or is it just the irrepressible Snoopy playing a trick on the kids?
8f1508807086a6fe518dd409feec9bbe.tagline: Put all your eggs in one basket.

8f1739208bac34b51a7404412def9dfc.overview: Alejandro is an aspiring toy designer from El Salvador, struggling to bring his unusual ideas to life in New York City. As time on his work visa runs out, a job assisting an erratic art-world outcast becomes his only hope to stay in the country and realize his dream.

8f2b6cd5d9bde1fcc0447063e608f788.overview: After an abrupt and violent encounter with a French warship inflicts severe damage upon his ship, a captain of the British Royal Navy begins a chase over two oceans to capture or destroy the enemy, though he must weigh his commitment to duty and ferocious pursuit of glory against the safety of his devoted crew, including the ship's thoughtful surgeon, his best friend.
8f2b6cd5d9bde1fcc0447063e608f788.tagline: The courage to do the impossible lies in the hearts of men.

8f46ba7819dcff3bd37f91d34da84c5d.overview: An escaped convict, injured during a robbery, falls in love with the woman who nurses him back to health, but their relationship seems doomed from the beginning.
8f46ba7819dcff3bd37f91d34da84c5d.tagline: Cops or no cops I'm going through!

8f5c143f3d28ae9336c2d7fe3dcd670a.overview: The Four Musketeers defend the queen and her dressmaker from Cardinal Richelieu and Milady de Winter.
8f5c143f3d28ae9336c2d7fe3dcd670a.tagline: What could be better than The Three Musketeers?

8f71bea057c56d375bfecbdc51fd08dd.overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.
8f71bea057c56d375bfecbdc51fd08dd.tagline: One ring to rule them all.

8f76969851f4a3d7d40780fa42d44d1a.overview: In the misty forests of North America, a family of Sasquatches—possibly the last of their enigmatic kind—embark on an absurdist, epic, hilarious, and ultimately poignant journey over the course of one year. These shaggy and noble giants fight for survival as they find themselves on a collision course with the ever-changing world around them.

8f8411a794dcb446397d9aef81b0be4b.overview: Architect Mark Wallace and his wife, Joanna, travel to France to meet with an affluent client. While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship, and of road trips through the French countryside. As flirtation and playful quarreling turn to boredom with the banality of married life, the Wallaces struggle to rekindle their passion, while mutual infidelity threatens to tear them apart.
8f8411a794dcb446397d9aef81b0be4b.tagline: They make something wonderful out of being alive!

8f925b60ca0329716e113bfeabc0abf3.overview: A young woman runs away from an abusive home and pre-arranged marriage only to be frustrated in her attempts to find happiness with a handsome engineer.
8f925b60ca0329716e113bfeabc0abf3.tagline: She sought the sweet fruits of living, snatching at each bit of happiness....what if the world did call her bad.

8f930c0f744c2f06a71bb300150de2e7.overview: In 1905, after 10 years of missionary work in Africa, the Rev. Charles Fortesque is recalled to England, where his bishop gives him his new assignment - to minister to London's prostitutes.

8f97ba9d315fa41e14a1a4ffd01b0c80.overview: Under the watchful eye of his mentor, Captain Mike Kennedy, probationary firefighter Jack Morrison matures into a seasoned veteran at a Baltimore fire station. However, Jack has reached a crossroads  as the sacrifices he's made have put him in harm's way innumerable times and significantly impacted his relationship with his wife and kids.
8f97ba9d315fa41e14a1a4ffd01b0c80.tagline: Their greatest challenge lies in rescuing one of their own.

8f9aa0a49c9642c2dc9a98ca1c059969.overview: Two neighbours — a persecuted journalist and a resigned housewife — forge a strong bond on the day of Adolf Hitler's historic 1938 visit to Rome.
8f9aa0a49c9642c2dc9a98ca1c059969.tagline: A special film about two special people.

8fa47d1f6c9a599519c473b6132a61a8.overview: Longfellow Deeds lives in a small town, leading a small town kind of life. When a relative dies and leaves Deeds a fortune, Longfellow moves to the big city where he becomes an instant target for everyone. Deeds outwits them all until Babe Bennett comes along. When small-town boy meets big-city girl anything can, and does, happen.

8fa7766c3b6682c8d0d1b946bc86d22b.overview: After being expelled from Beecher Prep for his treatment of a classmate with a facial deformity, Julian has struggled to fit in at his new school. To transform his life, Julian's grandmother finally reveals her own story of courage of her youth in Nazi-occupied France, where a classmate shelters her from mortal danger.
8fa7766c3b6682c8d0d1b946bc86d22b.tagline: One act of kindness lives on forever.

8fb36caaba10f3fd942713fa2d12ad32.overview: Single dad Richard meets Christine, a starving artist who moonlights as a cabbie. They awkwardly attempt to start a romance, but Richard’s divorce has left him emotionally damaged. Meanwhile, Richard’s sons—one a teenager, the other 6-years-old—take part in clumsy experiments with the opposite sex.

8fbd65423237be3442de774263cd1aca.overview: The story of an old Jewish widow named Daisy Werthan and her relationship with her black chauffeur, Hoke. From an initial mere work relationship grew in 25 years a strong friendship between the two very different characters, in a time when those types of relationships were shunned.
8fbd65423237be3442de774263cd1aca.tagline: The funny, touching and totally irresistible story of a working relationship that became a 25-year friendship.

8fcc33a2aae760962387328b3bf6de04.overview: A group of newcomers to the country music business seek love and stardom.

8ffacc909c837afb8f313849e592d273.overview: When actress Nikki Grace gets the lead role in a cursed film, her world becomes more and more surreal, blending realities and ideas of infidelity, reincarnation, and supernatural forces.
